title: Is my hat in this bag?
scene: 找帽子，逐处确认在不在。

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Is my hat in this bag?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Which bag are you looking in?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: The red one. But it's not in here.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: You can try the hook in the closet.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: There it is! How did it get all the way up there?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: I guess it was a little bit of magic.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: It's more like I forgot again, I think.

variations: "hat" 换 "gloves"；"in the bag" 换 "on the shelf"。
